rca_of_issue: Flicker RCA: previous impl used google.maps.Map.addListener('idle', ...) which fires not only when the user finishes a pan/zoom but ALSO on every tile-load and camera-settle (including the initial fit-to-bounds animation). Each idle fire posted a message to the RN parent which triggered a reverse-geocode, causing the 'Resolving…' pill to flash repeatedly even when idle. Fix: replaced with 'dragend' + 'zoom_changed' (only real user gestures) + a userInteracted guard so the initial zoom_changed from the map-init flow is ignored, and RN-side lastResolvedRef/inFlightRef dedupes. Hydration RCA: hydration effect previously only set State/City when the returned qark/bashkia strings matched an entry in the Albanian qark/bashkia lookup table — if Google returned a spelling variant (e.g. 'Durrës County' vs the lookup's 'Durrës'), the fields stayed blank. Fix: always fall back to the raw Google string when the lookup misses, and always set area (empty allowed). Verified with Durrës autocomplete pick: fields populated Country=Albania, State=Durrës, City=Durrës, Area='Rruga Kristo Sotiri 81', Postal='2001'.
